headline: Deeper Private Markets Integration And Stronger 2026 Outlook Might Change The Case For Investing In S&P Global (SPGI)
summary: S&P Global recently expanded its S&P Capital IQ Pro platform by integrating With Intelligence’s private markets data and editorial insights, following its 2025 acquisition, while also reporting higher second-quarter 2026 revenue, earnings and updated full‑year 2026 guidance including expected GAAP revenue growth, diluted EPS and operating margin expansion. This combination of deeper private markets coverage and AI‑enabled workflows means users can manage the full private investment lifecycle...
